verified_facts.text: Grand Hyatt Berlin stands at Potsdamer Platz.
verified_facts.excerpt: Grand Hyatt Berlin stands at Potsdamer Platz, the square at the heart of Berlin's transformation.

verified_facts.text: Brandenburg Gate, the Reichstag Building and the Tiergarten are all within walking distance of the hotel.
verified_facts.excerpt: with Brandenburg Gate, the Reichstag Building and the Tiergarten all within walking distance

verified_facts.text: The hotel houses a curated collection of over 120 pieces of art, displayed from the lobby to the restaurants and rooms.
verified_facts.excerpt: Our curated collection of over 120 pieces of art was carefully selected to intrigue, surprise and create a vibrant and interesting atmosphere throughout the Hotel.

verified_facts.text: Artists in the hotel's collection include Sylvie Fleury, John Armleder, Gunther Forg, Dieter Roth and Jaehyo Lee.
verified_facts.excerpt: Sylvie Fleury, John Armleder, Günther Förg, Dieter Roth and Jaehyo Lee are only a few of the names that have created the art you can explore throughout the hotel.

verified_facts.text: Club Olympus Spa & Fitness occupies the 8th floor, with panoramic views across the Berlin skyline.
verified_facts.excerpt: Club Olympus Spa & Fitness occupies the 8th floor of Grand Hyatt Berlin, offering spectacular panoramic views across the Berlin skyline

verified_facts.text: The spa has an indoor pool, whirlpool, outdoor terrace, sauna, steam bath, solarium and fitness area.
verified_facts.excerpt: An indoor pool, whirlpool, outdoor terrace, sauna, steam bath, solarium and fitness area are all available, complemented by a full program of cosmetic treatments and massages.

verified_facts.text: Access to Club Olympus Spa & Fitness is complimentary for hotel guests during their stay.
verified_facts.excerpt: Club Olympus Spa & Fitness is complimentary for hotel guests, with jogging routes through the Tiergarten nearby.

verified_facts.text: Rooms have marble bathrooms with a deep soaking tub and walk-in shower, appointed with Balmain amenities.
verified_facts.excerpt: while the marble bathroom features a deep soaking tub and walk-in shower, appointed with Balmain amenities.

verified_facts.text: The Junior Suite overlooks the greenery of the Tiergarten, with cherrywood and marble finishes.
verified_facts.excerpt: all overlooking the peaceful greenery of the Tiergarten. Rich cherrywood and marble finishes add warmth and refinement throughout

verified_facts.text: The Maybach Suite has a grand piano and a private conference room.
verified_facts.excerpt: elegant living and working spaces with a grand piano and a private conference room

verified_facts.text: The Grand Club on the 7th floor offers a complimentary continental breakfast buffet, all-day refreshments and an evening cocktail hour with canapes.
verified_facts.excerpt: Each day begins with a complimentary continental breakfast buffet, followed by all-day refreshments in a lounge designed equally for relaxation, work or informal meetings.

verified_facts.text: VOX Restaurant & Terrace is named after the historic Vox-Haus that once stood on the site.
verified_facts.excerpt: Named after the historic Vox-Haus that once stood on this site, VOX Restaurant & Terrace has been a Berlin dining institution since 1998.

verified_facts.text: VOX Bar has a collection of more than 300 spirits and whiskies.
verified_facts.excerpt: VOX Bar is one of Berlin's most celebrated bars, home to a collection of more than 300 spirits and whiskies.

verified_facts.text: The Very Important Baby program provides cribs, nightlights, diapers, baby-changing facilities and children's bathrobes.
verified_facts.excerpt: The Very Important Baby program provides cribs, nightlights, diapers, baby-changing facilities and children's bathrobes

verified_facts.text: The V.I.D. (Very Important Dog) service welcomes dogs with treats, a dog bed, matching bowls and a map of local walking routes.
verified_facts.excerpt: with treats, a personalized welcome card, a cozy dog bed, matching bowls and a map of the best local walking routes.

verified_facts.text: The modern sandstone hotel was designed by Jose Rafael Moneo.
verified_facts.excerpt: This modern sandstone hotel in a mixed-use development, designed by José Rafael Moneo

verified_facts.text: Design elements include a crystal-shaped roof light, Lebanese cedarwood, black granite and backlit alabaster walls.
verified_facts.excerpt: Design elements include a crystal-shaped roof light, Lebanese cedarwood, black granite, stucco posts, backlit alabaster walls, and a large atrium lobby.

verified_facts.text: The hotel is steps from the Potsdamer Platz U-Bahn station and a short walk to the site of the Berlin Wall.
